meta.layers: name = base layer; name#shirt and name#hair are grayscale tint layers drawn on top, same size and anchor

rig.units: Sprite pixels. Anchor every character frame at its bottom center.

tint.hair: hair color: sha256(utf8(wallet))[2] mod 6; style: sha256(utf8(wallet))[1] mod 5 in hairStyles order ('none' draws no hair)

emp.sit.front.use: Seated at the desk, between tasks; new hire

emp.sit.land.use: One frame on sitting down (the squash, §14.1), then emp.sit.front

emp.type.use: Working: turned to the monitor while a task is open

emp.cheer.use: Seated, passed at results or paid on payday; 0.6 s, once

emp.slump.use: Seated, missed at results; 0.6 s, once, then hold frame 1 for 1 s

emp.sit.side.use: P1 idle at the desk: leaning back, thinking

emp.stand.front.use: Standing still facing out: waiting, riding the elevator

emp.stand.side.use: Standing in profile: at the printer, the window, waiting for the elevator

emp.walk.use: Walking (24 px/s, 8 fps); running is emp.run, the same frames at 48 px/s, 16 fps

emp.carry.use: Layoff walk-out with the box and the desk plant

emp.climb.use: Climbing a flight of stairs (1.6 s per floor); mirror on the flights that rise to the left

emp.drink.use: At the water cooler or the coffee machine

emp.chat.use: Water-cooler chat; partners face each other (one mirrored)

emp.bench.use: Laid off: on the street bench with prop.box.full beside; frame 0 head down, frame 1 looking up

emp.visitor.use: Visitor in the sidewalk queue; outline only, never filled (animation emp.visitor.shuffle)

boss.smug|smile|twitchy.use: Penthouse, standing; face from the latest pass rate (§17.1)

boss.walk.use: Pacing the penthouse, coming down for a layoff; carries the mug

boss.point.use: Pointing at the employee being laid off

boss.sip.use: Penthouse idle: a sip from the mug

attach.flame: centered on the character, the flame's bottom on the character's row 12 (shoulders), drawn behind the character
attach.bench: emp.bench frames stand on the ground line like standing frames; prop.box.full sits on the bench seat beside them

rig.desk: Seated frames end at the desk top. Draw the room back, the chair, the character, then room.<tier>.front.

building.units: Sprite pixels from the building's left edge (x) and each band's ceiling (y), y down.
building.bands: Top to bottom: roof, penthouse, tier floors (Directors, Managers, Associates, Interns), lobby, street, basement. A floor band is floor.h tall plus a slab of floor.slab rows below it; feet stand on the slab's first row (y = floor.h).

shell.wall: shell.<state>.wall tiles down both outer walls (x 0 and x 376) over each band's interior; shell.<state>.window on the right wall at y 12 of every floor (the bay's window point); shell.<state>.slab where each slab meets the wall
shell.parapet: shell.<state>.parapet along the roof line, above the penthouse
shell.front: shell.<state>.front, one per 72 px across the lobby's rooms from x 48, then the doors in the bay: in front of lobby characters, behind street characters
shell.slab: bldg.slab tiles across x 48..376 under every floor; the core tiles carry their own slab

core.stairs: core.stairs at (stairs.x, floor top) on every floor from the lobby to the top tier; core.stairs.top in the penthouse. Climb: from (x 2, floor line) up the lower flight to the landing, then up the upper flight to (x 2, y -4), the next floor's line. Mirror the character on the upper flight.
core.tube: core.tube at (tube.x, band top) on every band from the basement to the top tier; core.tube.cap on top; core.tube.foot in the basement

outlet.note: core.tube.outlet on every tier floor: coins pop out of the mouth and arc to the desks

core.shaft: core.shaft on every floor from the lobby to the top tier; core.shaft.top in the penthouse

cab.note: core.cab top-left = (29, floor line - 30); riders stand on its row 30, inside x 30..45; core.cab.door.<0|1|2> over the riders

indicator.note: core.indicator.<off|up|down> above the shaft on every floor

clock.note: wall.clock, then wall.clock.hand.<0..7> for the share of the window left (0 = full)

outboxSheets.note: prop.sheets.<1..6>, one sheet per submission from the floor

plaque.note: tier name and headcount in screen-size text, on the first floor of each tier

posters.note: wall.poster.<0..2> on the interns' back wall, one per 72 px from x 102 (decoration)

building.roomTiles: room.<tier>.back behind the chair; room.<tier>.front (or .empty) in front of the seated character; rooms start at rooms.x and repeat every rooms[tier].w. Directors' rooms close with room.directors.wall at the right end (x 332).

boss.note: the boss stands on the penthouse floor line, y 64

doors.note: lobby.door.glass.<n> (lobby.rollup.<n> in the garage) fill the bay, in the street front's layer

crowdSign.note: paper sign taped on the glass left of the doors (spec §12.5); prop.tape at its top corners; text in the 13 px label style

street.note: street.pavement tiles across the full stage width; the sidewalk is in front of the lobby, so street characters overlap the lobby's street front

bench.note: up to 4 laid-off employees (emp.bench), then a +n sign; prop.box.full beside the last seat

queue.note: visitors (emp.visitor) facing the doors, up to 5, then +n

door.note: characters step out of the doors (the lobby floor line) and down to the sidewalk (standY) in 0.4 s: walking toward the viewer

basement.ceiling: the first 3 rows are the ground-floor slab under the sidewalk (concrete shade)

bar.note: fill = min(1, runway_tasks / 30) in the coin color, Bad when low (spec §4.6)

roof.sign: sign.<state>, centered on the rooms, standing on the roof line
